heroHeadline: Ukraine Says Allies Gave No Intelligence Warning Before Russian Strikes for Two Consecutive Nights
heroSubtitle: President Zelensky said allied partners gave no early warning before Russia's overnight barrage and that Moscow did not heed Trump's ceasefire call — while Russia separately signaled diesel exports could return to pre-invasion levels if the energy deal holds, framing the truce as economic opportunity.
